region_scene_page.compact: This road grows out of folk revival authorship, Brill Building craft, and album-era adult pop.
region_scene_page.standard: This road grows out of folk revival authorship, Brill Building craft, and album-era adult pop. Joni Mitchell's A Case of You, Neil Young's Old Man, Paul Simon's Kodachrome, and Gordon Lightfoot's Sundown give the scene its high-recognition landmarks.
region_scene_page.deep: This road grows out of folk revival authorship, Brill Building craft, and album-era adult pop. The songs ask to be heard as statements from a person, not just performances by a band. Joni Mitchell's A Case of You, Neil Young's Old Man, Paul Simon's Kodachrome, and Gordon Lightfoot's Sundown give the scene its high-recognition landmarks. From there, the examples move from quick recognition toward medium and deeper scene signals.
